_comment: `current` is the protocol version every SDK in this repository declares and
sends as `v` in each payload. `supported` is every version ingest accepts;
`current` is always in it. `refused` are versions ingest must answer with
Pinned to internal/protocol by internal/protocol/protocol_test.go. Edit both
together, and only for a breaking wire change.
`sdk` (#291; docs/SERVER_SDK_SPEC.md, "Phase 1 — the SDK's name and version"):
the optional `sdk: {name, version}` every flush may carry. `names` maps each
SDK's `name` to its directory in this repository: every SDK sends exactly its
own key, and its tests check the name it sends is the key for its directory.
A new SDK adds its name here and in the spec. `name_pattern` and
`version_pattern` are the rules ingest applies; `valid` are `sdk` values ingest
stores as sent; `invalid` are values ingest drops (stores "" for both, as if
absent) while accepting the flush exactly as without them. Never a 400.
The patterns match the whole value: Ruby \A...\z, Python re.fullmatch, never
Checked for consistency by internal/protocol/protocol_test.go; ingest (#295)
and every SDK (#307-#311) test against this section.

invalid.why: name ends with a newline (a $ that matches before a final newline)
name has a second line (a line-anchored ^...$)
